The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects contributors who are active. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (around line 735):

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- **Unmatched contributors:** only those whose latest commit is within 180 days of the analysis date go into the remainder. Dormant ones are left out.
- **Blank latest-commit date:** still counted as active. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so `isActive()` covers it and I added no extra check.
- **Configured teams:** unchanged. Their members are still matched before the remainder check, so they keep every member, active or not.

`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` ran with no failure output. The module has no existing tests for this class, and I did not add one or check the output of a specific team grouping. Nothing is committed.
